documents.title: Tamil Nadu Protection of Tanks and Eviction of Encroachment Act, 2007 (Act 8 of 2007)
documents.issuer: Legislative Assembly of Tamil Nadu / Water Resources Department
documents.licence_note: Public statutory enactment under Section 52(1)(q) of the Indian Copyright Act, 1957.
documents.designated_officer: Assistant Engineer / Junior Engineer (WRD Irrigation Section) & Tahsildar

clauses.clause: Section 4 & Section 6
clauses.text: Section 4 mandates the Survey Officer to survey irrigation tanks, fix boundary stones along the Full Tank Level (FTL) and foreshore, and publish the tank chart. Section 6 empowers the Officer of the Public Works / Water Resources Department to issue Form-II and Form-III notices directing any encroacher to remove the encroachment within 21 days.

clauses.clause: Section 7 & Section 8
clauses.text: Section 7 empowers the WRD Officer, with police and revenue assistance, to summarily evict any person failing to comply with a Section 6 notice and forfeit crops or structures erected inside the tank bed, bund, supply channel, or surplus course. Section 8 prescribes imprisonment up to 3 months or fine for unlawful entry, bund damage, or obstruction of water flow.

documents.title: Tamil Nadu Protection of Tanks and Eviction of Encroachment Rules, 2007 (G.O. Ms. No. 320, PWD)
documents.issuer: Public Works Department (Water Resources Organization), Govt. of Tamil Nadu
documents.licence_note: Public Government Order of Tamil Nadu (Section 52(1)(q) Indian Copyright Act).
documents.designated_officer: Assistant Executive Engineer (WRD Sub-Division) & Revenue Tahsildar

clauses.clause: Rule 3 & Rule 4 (Forms I, II, III)
clauses.text: Rule 3 requires preparation of the Register of Tanks in Form-I verified jointly by the Revenue Tahsildar and WRD Assistant Engineer. Rule 4 stipulates that public notice of tank boundaries shall be published in Form-II in the village chavadi and Panchayat office, followed by individual eviction notice in Form-III.

clauses.clause: Rule 6 (Recovery of Eviction Cost)
clauses.text: Rule 6 provides that all expenses incurred by the Water Resources Department in demolishing unauthorised buildings, walls, or infilling inside the water spread area shall be recovered from the encroacher as arrears of land revenue.

documents.title: G.O. (Ms) No. 58, Public Works (W2) Department — Implementation of Kudimaramath Scheme for Community-Led Tank Restoration
documents.issuer: Public Works Department (Water Resources Department), Govt. of Tamil Nadu
documents.licence_note: Public Government Order of Tamil Nadu.
documents.designated_officer: Executive Engineer (WRD Division) & District Collector

clauses.clause: Para 4 (Scope of Permissible Works)
clauses.text: Permissible works under Kudimaramath include desilting of supply channels, strengthening of tank bunds to standard TBL (Tank Bund Level), reconstruction of damaged masonry sluices and surplus weirs (kalingals), and clearing of Prosopis juliflora (Seemai Karuvelam) from the water spread area.

clauses.clause: Para 6 (Ayacutdar & WUA Participation)
clauses.text: Works up to Rs. 10 lakhs may be nominated directly to registered Water Users Associations (WUAs) / Ayacutdar Sangams with a mandatory 10% community contribution (cash or labour) and 90% State Government grant audited by the WRD Assistant Executive Engineer.

documents.title: G.O. (Ms) No. 64, Public Works (W2) Department — Kudimaramath Operational Guidelines & Transparency Mandate
documents.issuer: Public Works Department (WRD), Govt. of Tamil Nadu
documents.licence_note: Public Government Order of Tamil Nadu.
documents.designated_officer: Superintending Engineer (WRD Circle) & Executive Engineer

clauses.clause: Guideline 5.2 (Pre-Monsoon Desilting & Bund Standards)
clauses.text: All tank bunds exhibiting gullies, piping, or freeboard below 1.5 meters above Maximum Water Level (MWL) must be prioritised for pre-monsoon strengthening using excavated tank-bed silt prior to October 1st.

clauses.clause: Guideline 7.1 (Public Display Board & Geo-Tagged Photographs)
clauses.text: Every Kudimaramath work site must display a permanent Tamil information board stating tank ayacut, estimate amount, depth of desilting, and officer contact, supported by before, during, and after geo-tagged photographs.

documents.title: G.O. (Ms) No. 98, Public Works (W2) Department — Kudimaramath Phase-III Palar & Lower Palar Basin Tanks
documents.issuer: Public Works Department (WRD), Govt. of Tamil Nadu
documents.licence_note: Public Government Order of Tamil Nadu.
documents.designated_officer: Executive Engineer, Lower Palar Basin Division, Kancheepuram

clauses.clause: Para 3 & Annexure-II (Palar Basin Tank Chains)
clauses.text: System and non-system tanks in Kancheepuram and Chengalpattu districts under the Lower Palar Basin Division must restore feeder supply channels (வரத்து கால்வாய்) and surplus escape courses (மறுகால்) so cascading overflow reaches downstream tanks without flooding residential habitations.

clauses.clause: Para 8 (Grievance Redressal for Sub-Standard Work)
clauses.text: Complaints by villagers or Panchayat Presidents regarding incomplete desilting, illegal sand mining disguised as desilting, or defective sluice shutters must be inspected by the Executive Engineer within 7 working days.

documents.title: Tamil Nadu Farmers' Management of Irrigation Systems Act, 2000 (Act 7 of 2001)
documents.issuer: Legislative Assembly of Tamil Nadu
documents.licence_note: Public statutory enactment (Section 52(1)(q) Indian Copyright Act).
documents.designated_officer: Competent Authority (Assistant Engineer WRD) & WUA President

clauses.clause: Section 17 (Functions of Water Users Association)
clauses.text: Section 17 empowers the Water Users Association (WUA) of a tank to prepare and implement the rotational water-supply schedule (Warabandi), maintain irrigation channels and sluices, and report any unauthorised water drawal or encroachment to the Competent WRD Authority.

clauses.clause: Section 28 (Offences & Penalties for Sluice Tampering)
clauses.text: Whoever damages, alters, enlarges, or obstructs any tank bund, sluice (மதகு), calingulah (கலிங்கல்), or supply channel commits a cognizable statutory offence punishable under Section 28.

documents.title: Tamil Nadu Land Encroachment Act, 1905 (Act III of 1905) — Water-Course Poramboke Provisions
documents.issuer: Revenue and Disaster Management Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
documents.licence_note: Public statutory enactment (Section 52(1)(q) Indian Copyright Act).
documents.designated_officer: Revenue Tahsildar & Revenue Divisional Officer (RDO)

clauses.clause: Section 2 & Section 7 (Prior Notice on Eri Poramboke)
clauses.text: Under Section 2, all beds of tanks (Eri Poramboke), supply channels, and bunds are the absolute property of the Government. Section 7 requires the Tahsildar or Deputy Tahsildar to serve a show-cause notice before passing a Section 6 eviction order on non-WRD Panchayat Union tanks.

clauses.clause: Section 6 (Summary Eviction & Forfeiture)
clauses.text: Under Section 6, any person unauthorisedly occupying Eri Poramboke or Odai (stream) land shall be summarily evicted by the Collector or Tahsildar, and any building or construction erected thereon is liable to forfeiture and demolition.

documents.title: Tamil Nadu Panchayats Act, 1994 (Act 21 of 1994) — Section 133 Maintenance of Minor Irrigation Tanks
documents.issuer: Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
documents.licence_note: Public statutory enactment (Section 52(1)(q) Indian Copyright Act).
documents.designated_officer: Block Development Officer (BDO - Village Panchayats) & Panchayat President

clauses.clause: Section 133(1) (Panchayat Union Minor Irrigation Tanks)
clauses.text: Minor irrigation tanks with an ayacut below 40 hectares (100 acres) not under WRD control vest in the Panchayat Union Council for protection, bund maintenance, and auction of fishery/usufruct rights.

clauses.clause: Section 131(2) (Duty to Remove Obstructions in Public Water Sources)
clauses.text: It is the statutory duty of the Village Panchayat Executive Authority and Block Development Officer to initiate immediate action with the Revenue Tahsildar to remove encroachments in village ooranis, kulams, and minor irrigation tanks.

documents.title: L. Krishnan v. State of Tamil Nadu (2005 (4) CTC 1) — Mandatory Restoration of Water Bodies to Original Extent
documents.issuer: High Court of Judicature at Madras (Division Bench)
documents.licence_note: Public judicial pronouncement under Section 52(1)(q)(iv) Indian Copyright Act.
documents.designated_officer: District Collector, Revenue Divisional Officer & Executive Engineer (WRD)

clauses.clause: Para 14 (Absolute Bar on Regularisation of Water-Body Encroachments)
clauses.text: The Division Bench held that under Article 21 and Article 48-A of the Constitution, the State is a public trustee of all natural water bodies (eris, odais, kulams) and shall never regularise or grant patta over land classified as a water body in the historical revenue records, even if the tank has fallen into disuse.

clauses.clause: Para 15 (Direction to Restore Historical Survey Boundaries)
clauses.text: District Collectors across Tamil Nadu are directed to identify all encroachments in irrigation tanks using original village FMB / A-Register surveys and restore the water bodies to their full historical water-spread extent.

documents.title: T.K. Shanmugam v. State of Tamil Nadu (2015 (5) LW 397 Full Bench) — Invalidation of Reclassification of Tanks
documents.issuer: High Court of Judicature at Madras (Full Bench)
documents.licence_note: Public judicial pronouncement under Section 52(1)(q)(iv) Indian Copyright Act.
documents.designated_officer: Commissioner of Land Administration, District Collector & WRD Executive Engineer

clauses.clause: Para 40 & Para 45 (Public Trust Doctrine on Shrinking Tanks)
clauses.text: The Full Bench ruled that shrinkage of a tank due to artificial blockage of inflow channels or urbanisation does not extinguish its character as a water body. Government Orders attempting to reclassify tank poramboke for housing or commercial allotment are unconstitutional and void.

clauses.clause: Para 48 (Strict Accountability of Revenue & WRD Officials)
clauses.text: Revenue and WRD officers who fail to act on complaints of tank-bed encroachment or who grant electricity/water connections to unauthorized structures inside tank boundaries are liable to departmental disciplinary proceedings.

documents.title: G.O. (Ms) No. 540, Revenue (LD6(2)) Department — Three-Tier Grievance Redressal Mechanism for Water-Body Encroachments
documents.issuer: Revenue and Disaster Management Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
documents.licence_note: Public Government Order of Tamil Nadu.
documents.designated_officer: Tahsildar (Original Petition), RDO (Appellate Committee), District Collector (Review Committee)

clauses.clause: Para 4(i) (30-Day Statutory Timeframe for Original Petitions)
clauses.text: Upon receipt of a written petition alleging encroachment in a water body or tank, the Tahsildar / Competent WRD Authority shall conduct a field survey, hear the parties, and complete eviction action within 30 days, communicating a speaking order to the petitioner.

clauses.clause: Para 4(ii)-(iii) (Divisional Appellate & District Review Committees)
clauses.text: If no action is taken within 30 days, the petitioner may file an appeal before the Divisional Appellate Committee chaired by the Revenue Divisional Officer (RDO) (20-day limit), and a further review before the District Review Committee chaired by the District Collector.

documents.title: G.O. (Ms) No. 64, Revenue and Disaster Management Department — Taluk, Divisional & District Committees for Water Body Protection
documents.issuer: Revenue and Disaster Management Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
documents.licence_note: Public Government Order of Tamil Nadu.
documents.designated_officer: Tahsildar (Taluk Committee Chair) & Executive Engineer WRD

clauses.clause: Para 5 (Taluk Level Monitoring Committee Composition & Monthly Review)
clauses.text: Constitutes a Taluk Level Monitoring Committee headed by the Tahsildar with the Assistant Engineer (WRD), Block Development Officer, and Town/Municipality officials to review and evict water-body encroachments every month.

clauses.clause: Para 7 (GIS / Satellite Monitoring & Boundary Stone Restoration)
clauses.text: Directs Taluk and District Committees to cross-verify physical FMB boundaries against satellite imagery to detect fresh shrinkage or dumping along tank foreshores.

documents.title: G.O. (Ms) No. 50, Industries (MMC.1) & PWD — Free Removal of Tank Silt (Savudu/Vandal) for Agricultural & Pottery Use
documents.issuer: Industries & Public Works Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
documents.licence_note: Public Government Order of Tamil Nadu.
documents.designated_officer: District Collector, Tahsildar & Assistant Engineer (WRD)

clauses.clause: Rule 12(2-A) Tamil Nadu Minor Mineral Concession Rules
clauses.text: Permits farmers and potters to excavate silt/vandal from notified PWD/WRD and Rural Development irrigation tanks free of seigniorage fee for agricultural soil enrichment, restoring lost storage capacity of silted tanks.

clauses.clause: Condition 4 & Condition 7 (Depth Limit & Bund Safety Buffer)
clauses.text: Excavation depth shall never exceed 1.5 meters below the sill level of the lowest sluice, and a strict 30-meter no-dig safety buffer must be maintained from the toe of the tank bund and masonry structures; commercial sale of excavated earth is strictly prohibited.

documents.title: Tamil Nadu WRD Northeast Monsoon Tank Safety, Patrol & Flood Regulation Standing Orders, 2021
documents.issuer: Engineer-in-Chief, Water Resources Department, Chepauk, Chennai
documents.licence_note: Public operational manual of Tamil Nadu Water Resources Department.
documents.designated_officer: Assistant Engineer (WRD), Executive Engineer & District Disaster Management Authority

clauses.clause: Chapter 3, Clause 3.4 (Monsoon Storage & Freeboard Rules)
clauses.text: When a non-system or system tank reaches 80% of Full Tank Level (FTL) during heavy Northeast Monsoon rainfall forecasts, the Assistant Engineer (WRD) must deploy 24x7 Lashkar/Kavalarkarar bund patrols, stock sandbags at vulnerable bund reaches, and clear all obstructions in the surplus weir (kalingal).

clauses.clause: Chapter 4, Clause 4.2 (Three-Stage Flood Warning Protocol)
clauses.text: When tank inflow causes water level to touch FTL and surplus discharge begins over the weir, the WRD Executive Engineer and Revenue Tahsildar must issue First, Second, and Third Flood Warnings to downstream habitations before operating flood regulators.

documents.title: G.O. (Ms) No. 214, Public Works Department — Revised Flood Regulation Curve & Alert Protocol for Chembarambakkam Tank (Adyar Sub-Basin)
documents.issuer: Public Works Department (Water Resources Organization), Govt. of Tamil Nadu
documents.licence_note: Public Government Order of Tamil Nadu.
documents.designated_officer: Executive Engineer, Kosasthalaiyar / Palar Basin Division (WRD) & Collector Kancheepuram

clauses.clause: Clause 2.1 (Rule Curve & Pre-Release Notification)
clauses.text: Mandates continuous monitoring of catchment rainfall, inflow (cusecs), and water-spread storage in Chembarambakkam Tank (Full Capacity 3,645 Mcft / 24.0 ft), with mandatory prior intimation to Kancheepuram, Chengalpattu, and Greater Chennai Collectors before opening surplus shutters.

clauses.clause: Clause 5.3 (Protection of Upstream Supply Channels)
clauses.text: All upstream feeder channels from Sriperumbudur, Pillaipakkam, and Nemili tanks leading into Chembarambakkam must be kept clear of industrial or residential obstructions prior to October 15th each year.

documents.title: NGT Southern Zone Original Application No. 125 of 2020 (SZ) — Prevention of Sewage Inflow and Solid Waste Dumping in Sembakkam, Medavakkam & Perumbakkam Lakes
documents.issuer: National Green Tribunal, Southern Zone Bench, Chennai
documents.licence_note: Public judicial order under Section 52(1)(q)(iv) Indian Copyright Act.
documents.designated_officer: District Collector Chengalpattu, Commissioner Tambaram City Municipal Corporation & TNPCB District Environmental Engineer

clauses.clause: Para 22 & Direction (a) (Zero Untreated Sewage & Solid Waste in Tanks)
clauses.text: The Tribunal directed the Chengalpattu District Collector, Water Resources Department, and local bodies to immediately plug all unauthorised storm-water drains discharging untreated domestic sewage or septage into Sembakkam, Medavakkam, and Perumbakkam irrigation tanks.

clauses.clause: Direction (c) (Environmental Compensation under Polluter Pays Principle)
clauses.text: The Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board (TNPCB) is mandated to levy Environmental Compensation under Section 5 of the Environment (Protection) Act and the Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974 against any local body or commercial establishment dumping construction debris (C&D waste) or garbage on tank bunds and foreshores.

documents.title: NGT Southern Zone Original Application No. 82 of 2021 (SZ) — Foreshore Fencing, Bund Strengthening & Inlet Channel Protection for Chitlapakkam & Kolavai Lakes
documents.issuer: National Green Tribunal, Southern Zone Bench, Chennai
documents.licence_note: Public judicial order under Section 52(1)(q)(iv) Indian Copyright Act.
documents.designated_officer: Executive Engineer (WRD Lower Palar Basin), Collector Chengalpattu & TNPCB

clauses.clause: Para 18 (ProtectiveFencing & Bioremediation of Urbanising Tanks)
clauses.text: Directs WRD to erect boundary pillars and protective chain-link fencing along vulnerable peri-urban tank boundaries after completing Form-I/II surveys under the 2007 Tank Protection Act to prevent repeat encroachment.

clauses.clause: Para 21 (Restoration of Supply & Surplus Channels)
clauses.text: Orders that restoring a tank requires restoring both its feeder channel (வரத்து கால்வாய்) and surplus escape channel (மறுகால் கால்வாய்) to their original FMB width.

documents.title: NGT Southern Zone O.A. No. 198 of 2021 (SZ) — Protection of Cascading Tank Chains along OMR / IT Corridor (Thaiyur, Siruseri, Kelambakkam, Paiyanur)
documents.issuer: National Green Tribunal, Southern Zone Bench, Chennai
documents.licence_note: Public judicial order under Section 52(1)(q)(iv) Indian Copyright Act.
documents.designated_officer: District Collector Chengalpattu, Member Secretary CMDA/DTCP & Executive Engineer WRD

clauses.clause: Para 16 (Mandatory Culverts & Unobstructed Cross-Drainage)
clauses.text: Real-estate layouts, industrial parks, and road-widening projects in Thiruporur and Kattankolathur blocks shall not obstruct or narrow natural overland flow paths or inter-tank supply channels connecting Thaiyur, Siruseri, Kelambakkam, and Paiyanur eris.

clauses.clause: Para 19 (Revocation of Planning Permission on Tank Foreshores)
clauses.text: Planning authorities (CMDA / DTCP) and Village Panchayats are prohibited from granting building approvals within the Full Tank Level (FTL) or statutory buffer zone of any irrigation tank without a No-Objection Certificate (NOC) from the WRD Executive Engineer.

documents.title: Madras High Court W.P. (MD) No. 22163 of 2015 / Full Bench Orders on Eradication of Prosopis juliflora (Seemai Karuvelam) from Water Bodies
documents.issuer: High Court of Judicature at Madras
documents.licence_note: Public judicial pronouncement under Section 52(1)(q)(iv) Indian Copyright Act.
documents.designated_officer: District Collector, Executive Engineer (WRD) & Block Development Officer

clauses.clause: Para 12 (Mandatory Root-Level Uprooting of Seemai Karuvelam in Tanks)
clauses.text: Directs District Collectors, WRD officers, and Village Panchayats to uproot invasive Prosopis juliflora (சீமை கருவேலம்) and water hyacinth (ஆகாயத்தாமரை) from tank beds and bunds, as they deplete groundwater recharge and reduce surface storage capacity.

documents.title: Board of Revenue Standing Order (RSO) No. 15, Paragraph 38 — Prohibition on Assignment of Tank Bed & Water-Course Poramboke
documents.issuer: Commissioner of Land Administration / Revenue Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
documents.licence_note: Public Revenue Standing Order of Tamil Nadu.
documents.designated_officer: Commissioner of Land Administration, District Revenue Officer (DRO) & Tahsildar

clauses.clause: RSO 15, Para 38(ii) (Prohibition of Assignment inside FTL & Foreshore)
clauses.text: Lands classified as Eri Ulvoy (tank bed), Kalvai (supply channel), Odai (stream), or Kalingal (surplus course) are strictly prohibited from assignment or patta transfer. Even temporary cultivation (B-Memo penalty) inside the tank bed is barred, as ploughing loosens silt and accelerates tank shallowing.

documents.title: G.O. (Ms) No. 138, Public Works Department — Guidelines for Repair, Renovation and Restoration (RRR) of Irrigation Tanks under PMKSY
documents.issuer: Public Works Department (Water Resources Department), Govt. of Tamil Nadu
documents.licence_note: Public Government Order of Tamil Nadu.
documents.designated_officer: Chief Engineer (WRD Plan Formulation) & Executive Engineer

clauses.clause: Para 3 (Eligibility of Shrinking & Silted Tanks for RRR Funding)
clauses.text: Irrigation tanks with a command area (ayacut) of 40 hectares or more showing storage loss exceeding 15% due to siltation, damaged masonry sluices, or breached bunds are eligible for priority sanction under the RRR of Water Bodies component, subject to boundary demarcation and encroachment eviction.

documents.title: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974 (Act 6 of 1974) — Section 24 Prohibition on Disposal of Polluting Matter into Tanks & Streams
documents.issuer: Parliament of India / Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board (TNPCB)
documents.licence_note: Public Central Statute (Section 52(1)(q) Indian Copyright Act).
documents.designated_officer: District Environmental Engineer (TNPCB) & Executive Engineer (WRD)

clauses.clause: Section 24(1)(a)-(b) (Prohibition on Polluting Matter & Impeding Flow)
clauses.text: Section 24(1)(a) prohibits any person from knowingly causing or permitting any poisonous, noxious, or polluting matter (including untreated sewage, industrial effluent, or septage tankers) to enter any stream, well, or irrigation tank. Section 24(1)(b) prohibits depositing solid waste or debris that impedes the proper flow of water in a tank or channel.

clauses.clause: Section 43 (Penalty for Contravention of Section 24)
clauses.text: Violation of Section 24 is punishable under Section 43 with imprisonment for a term not less than one year and six months extendable up to six years and fine.

documents.title: Disaster Management Act, 2005 (Act 53 of 2005) — Sections 30 & 34 Emergency Powers of District Authority for Imminent Tank Bund Breach
documents.issuer: Parliament of India / Tamil Nadu State Disaster Management Authority
documents.licence_note: Public Central Statute (Section 52(1)(q) Indian Copyright Act).
documents.designated_officer: District Collector (Chairperson, DDMA), Revenue Divisional Officer & WRD Executive Engineer

clauses.clause: Section 30 & Section 34(c)-(k) (Emergency Bund Breach & Flood Mitigation)
clauses.text: Where an irrigation tank faces imminent overflow or bund breach risk during extreme rainfall, Section 34 empowers the District Disaster Management Authority (District Collector) to requisition earth-moving machinery, remove unauthorized obstructions across surplus escape channels immediately, and evacuate vulnerable foreshore/downstream habitations.

documents.title: G.O. (Ms) No. 172, Rural Development and Panchayat Raj (CGS.1) Department — Convergence of MGNREGS for Minor Irrigation Tank & Supply Channel Desilting
documents.issuer: Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
documents.licence_note: Public Government Order of Tamil Nadu.
documents.designated_officer: Block Development Officer (BDO), Union Overseer & Panchayat President

clauses.clause: Para 4 (Supply Channel Clearance & Farm Pond / Recharge Shaft Works)
clauses.text: Authorises Village Panchayats and Block Development Officers to execute feeder channel (வரத்து கால்வாய்) clearance, field channel (மடை கால்வாய்) desilting, and groundwater recharge shafts inside minor irrigation tanks under MGNREGS prior to the onset of the monsoon.

documents.title: Tamil Nadu WRD Technical Circular No. WRD/CE-PF/14/2018 — Maintenance of Tank Sluice Shutters, Screw Gearing Rods & Surplus Calingulahs
documents.issuer: Chief Engineer (General), Water Resources Department, Chennai
documents.licence_note: Public Technical Circular of Tamil Nadu WRD.
documents.designated_officer: Assistant Engineer / Junior Engineer (WRD Irrigation Section)

clauses.clause: Clause 4.1 (Leak-Proof Sluice Shutters to Prevent Premature Drying)
clauses.text: Broken or corroded cast-iron/steel sluice shutters (மதகு ஷட்டர்) and missing screw-gearing rods cause continuous dead-storage leakage and premature tank drying before the Samba/Navarai harvest. Assistant Engineers (WRD) must inspect all tank sluices in August and repair leaking shutters within 15 days of receipt of a farmer or WUA complaint.

clauses.clause: Clause 4.3 (Prohibition on IllegalRaising of Surplus Weir Crest)
clauses.text: No person shall place unauthorized concrete blocks, sandbags, or earthen bunds above the designed crest level of a tank surplus weir (கலிங்கல்), as raising FTL submerges foreshore patta lands and endangers the earthen tank bund.

documents.title: Madras High Court W.P. No. 31245 of 2019 — Protection of Feeder Canals and Ayacut Supply Channels of Madurantakam & Uthiramerur Tanks
documents.issuer: High Court of Judicature at Madras
documents.licence_note: Public judicial pronouncement under Section 52(1)(q)(iv) Indian Copyright Act.
documents.designated_officer: Executive Engineer (WRD Lower Palar Basin), Tahsildar Madurantakam & Tahsildar Uthiramerur

clauses.clause: Para 9 (Duty to Maintain Kiliyar / Palar Anicut Supply Channels)
clauses.text: Directed the WRD Lower Palar Basin Division and Revenue Tahsildars of Madurantakam and Uthiramerur to survey and evict encroachments along the feeder canals supplying Madurantakam Periya Eri and Uthiramerur Eri and ensure tail-end ayacut farmers receive their rightful irrigation supply.

documents.title: G.O. (Ms) No. 295, Municipal Administration and Water Supply Department — Protection & Rejuvenation of Tanks in Peri-Urban Municipalities and Town Panchayats
documents.issuer: Municipal Administration and Water Supply (MAWS) Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
documents.licence_note: Public Government Order of Tamil Nadu.
documents.designated_officer: Municipal Commissioner / Executive Officer (Town Panchayat) & Executive Engineer WRD

clauses.clause: Para 6 (Interception & Diversion of Sewage Inlets in Peri-Urban Tanks)
clauses.text: Municipalities and Town Panchayats in Chengalpattu and Kancheepuram districts (including Tambaram, Maraimalai Nagar, Nandhivaram-Guduvancheri, Kundrathur, Sriperumbudur, and Thiruporur) must construct interception and diversion (I&D) drains so that municipal sullage does not enter WRD or minor irrigation tanks.

documents.title: G.O. (Ms) No. 41, Public Works / Water Resources Department — Bifurcation & Creation of Dedicated Water Resources Department (WRD) and Jurisdictional Matrix
documents.issuer: Water Resources Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
documents.licence_note: Public Government Order of Tamil Nadu.
documents.designated_officer: Additional Chief Secretary (WRD), Chief Engineer (Chennai Region) & Executive Engineer (Lower Palar Basin Division)

clauses.clause: Para 3 & Schedule-I (Jurisdictional Routing of Tank Grievances)
clauses.text: Establishes a standalone Water Resources Department (नीர்வளத்துறை) with exclusive jurisdiction over all major irrigation tanks (ayacut >= 40 ha) and system tanks. For tanks in Kancheepuram and Chengalpattu districts, field grievances regarding bund breaches, sluice repairs, and Form-III eviction notices lie with the Assistant Engineer / Executive Engineer, WRD Lower Palar Basin Division (Kancheepuram) and Kosasthalaiyar Basin Division, while revenue survey and FMB demarcation lie jointly with the jurisdictional Revenue Tahsildar.
